title: Let God Work In Your Life | All To Jesus I Surrender (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: imagine standing at the edge of a vast ocean knowing that hidden beneath the waves or Treasures Beyond Your Wildest Dreams you have the opportunity to unlock these riches but you hesitate what holds you back is it fear is it doubt or is it a belief that you can find the treasure on your own what if I told you that the vast ocean is your life and the opportunity is allowing God to guide you the treasures are the peace Joy love blessings

and purpose that come from living and according to God's perfect will today we're going to explore how to take the plunge surrender control and let God work in our lives to uncover the treasures he has prepared for us God has Treasures for you don't stand on the shore pondering the depths dive into his Embrace and discover the boundless Riches of his love and purpose for your life God's love for us is profound reaching out to us in ways that are beyond

our understanding he loves us so much that he gave his only son Jesus Christ to save us from our sins as one of my most loved Bible verse tells us in John 3 verse 16 for God so loved the world that he gave his only begotten son that whoever believes in him should not perish but have everlasting life God's love is a living reality seeking to touch Our Lives heal our wounds guide our paths and fill us with joy and peace

praise God but the human struggle often pulls us away from God's loving embrace we sometimes cling to control and resist his Divine guidance we see this happening in the story of Jonah who tried to run away from God's calling ending up in the belly of a large fish he thought he knew better than God but his resistance only led him into trouble just like Jonah our resistance can lead us into difficult places but our God is so good his grace and

mercy are always there to reach out to us God promises that when we allow him to work in our lives profound transformation happens we can see this in the story of Zacchaeus whose Encounter With Jesus changed his life completely he went from a tax collector who cheated people to someone who gave to the poor and made right his wrongs this transformation is not limited to Biblical times but is a living promise for everyone who opens their heart to God's love the

creator of all things has control over the entire universe he is Sovereign God's wisdom and love shape every aspect of existence from the stars in the sky to the birds in the air Genesis 1 verse 1 beautifully captures this in the beginning God created the heavens and the Earth every detail every moment every breath is under his wise control acknowledging this truth is humbling and liberating allowing us to trust in his Perfect Design in his perfect plan surrendering control to God

may seem frightening at first but it leads to profound peace by letting go of our worries and surrendering to God we open ourselves to God's care and guidance as Jesus invites Us in Matthew 11 verse 28. come to me all you who labor and are heavy laden and I will give you rest I have said this before surrendering doesn't mean weakness it means recognizing that God's ways are higher than our ways and trusting him with our lives it's a path towards

freedom and rest in his loving presence note that God's relationship with us is not one of dictatorship but of partnership he doesn't impose his will but invites us to walk with him just like he guided and supported Moses in leading the Israelites he offers us wisdom courage and companionship God's partnership is not a one-time offer but a lifelong journey filled with love support and guidance We Are Not Mere subjects we are his children called to walk hand in hand with our

heavenly father now we need to understand God's Will and purpose God's plan is perfect even when it doesn't match our expectations Joseph's story is a beautiful example of this who betrayed by his brothers and sold into slavery he trusted God's plan which eventually led him to a position of power save many lives Joseph could see God's hand in everything in Genesis 50 verse 20. he said you meant evil against me but God meant it for good to bring it about as

it is this day to save many people alive his trust in God's Perfection allowed him to forgive and embrace a higher purpose he was able to let go of the past and move forward towards something greater discovering Our Calling involves Discerning God's will for our individual lives it's not about selfish Ambitions but aligning with God's purpose Timothy's story teaches us that our calling may not align with worldly standards in first Timothy 4 verses 12. the Bible says let no one despise

your youth but be an example to the Believers in word in conduct in love in spirit in faith in purity Timothy's youth was not a barrier but an opportunity to live out God's calling likewise our circumstances don't Define Our Calling God's purpose does living purposefully means embracing God's plan and acting in alignment with his will Queen Esther's courage and sense of purpose in Saving her people is an inspiring example she understood that her position as Queen was not just a privilege

but a responsibility as to 4 14 shows that she realized she was placed there for such a time as this living according to God's purpose empowers us to make decisions that have lasting impacts bringing blessings to others and fulfillment to ourselves that's some of the benefits of Allowing God to work in your life so let's talk about the importance of faith and trust in this journey of surrendering to God's will faith is more than just believing it's a commitment to action

Abraham's story illustrates this vividly he trusted God's call leaving his home without knowing where he was going then we see in Hebrews 11 verse 8 where the Bible says by faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out to the place which he would receive as an inheritance so Abraham's Faith was rewarded with God's promises fulfilled we too can find blessings when we put our faith into action trusting God's guidance even when we don't see the whole picture overcoming doubt

is also an important part of the Journey of Faith I speak about this a lot because it is super important for us to have faith and we can't have faith while doubting it just doesn't work that way Hebrews 11 verse 6 tells us but without faith it is impossible to please him for he who comes to God must believe that he is and that he is a rewarder of those who diligently seek him now when the Israelites face the mighty Red

Sea they were filled with doubt and fear but Moses faith and God's promises enabled him to lead the people through in Exodus 14 verse 13 He said do not be afraid stand still and see the salvation of the Lord which he will accomplish for you today Moses encouraged them to stop doubting he encouraged them to have faith when we Face challenges we can overcome doubt by leaning into God's promises remembering that he has a way even when we see no way

even when we see no way trusting in God brings rewards of Peace joy and assurance in Matthew 14 verses 29 to 31 when Peter stepped out of the boat to walk on water he experienced the supernatural power of trust in Jesus though he began to sink when he doubted Jesus reached out to save him trusting in God is not a one-time act but an ongoing relationship when we keep our eyes fixed on him we can walk on the waves of Life

experiencing peace that passes all understanding now let us talk about some practical steps to let God work in our lives in our journey with God it's not enough to Simply acknowledge his presence we must actively seek to let him work within us this begins with seeking repentance a profound turning away from the things that separate us from God's love and grace it's an honest look into our hearts and an Earnest desire to make right what has gone wrong inviting the Holy

Spirit into our lives is also another crucial step in Allowing God to work within us the holy spirit is God's presence in our lives guiding us comforting us and empowering us to live according to his will it is the holy spirit that convicts us of our need for repentance in the first place and leads us into a deeper relationship with God seeking repentance and living a Godly life are significant but without the holy spirit's guidance we can feel lost and disconnected

by inviting the Holy Spirit into our hearts we open ourselves to Divine wisdom strength and love we allow God's spirit to transform our thoughts emotions and actions aligning them with his purpose the process of inviting the Holy Spirit is an act of surrender it's recognizing that we need God's guidance and Grace in every aspect of Our Lives living a Godly life is the next vital step it's more than a list of dues and don'ts it's aligning our daily lives with God's

principles embracing kindness compassion integrity and humility it's a continuous process of growth a Daily Commitment to follow God's teachings it's an ongoing relationship nurtured through prayer and meditation and the study of his word prayer and meditation are the means of connection and Guidance with God just like Jesus often withdrew to pray and seek his father's will we too can find direction and strength through prayer pray without ceasing we're told in first Thessalonians 5 17. persistent prayer helps us align our will

with God's Will and feel his presence in every circumstance it's not about presenting a wish list but it is about engaging in a loving conversation with our creator living a Godly life without immersing ourselves in the word of God is comparable to attempting to operate a sophisticated and newly purchased machine without consulting its manual just as understanding The Machine's intricacies requires careful study of its instructions truly walking in God's path demands a dedicated study of his word it's through this spiritual

guidance found in the scriptures that we discover the principles and wisdom to navigate the complexities of life growing closer to God and fulfilling his purpose for us Bible study also helps us understand God's Will and character in the book of Acts chapter 17 verse 11. the bereans were praised for studying the Scriptures Daily to discern the truth the scripture says these were more noble than those in thessalonica in that they received the word with all Readiness of mind and searched the

Scriptures Daily whether those things were so so like them we can find wisdom and guidance in God's word daily immersion in the Bible isn't a mere religious Duty it's a nourishing Feast for the soul it transforms our thinking shapes our values and directs our steps drawing us closer to God's heart today I challenge you to make concrete decisions to allow God to work in your life Joshua challenged the Israelites in Joshua 24 15 saying choose for yourselves this day whom you

will serve I am saying the same thing to you today choose for yourselves this day who you will serve the most important life choice anyone will ever make is their response to this fundamental question choose today who you are going to serve God or Satan the spirit or the flesh light or Darkness life or death Faith or fear the truth or the lie and remember this the man or woman mother or father who is prepared to lead in this important life

choice will most likely be the one that will influence those in their own household in this eternally significant decision and will be able to say with Joshua as for me and my house we will serve the Lord today we too have a choice will we surrender control trust God's plan live purposefully and walk in faith the choice is ours the choice is yours and the invitation is open the grace to say yes to God is available to us today God's promise

never to leave or forsake those who trust in him brings us Assurance in Deuteronomy 31 verse 6 God says be strong and of good courage do not fear nor be afraid of them for the Lord your God he is the one who goes with you he will not leave you nor forsake you this promise is not just for a particular time or people but for all who put their trust in God it's an anchor for our souls it is a guarantee

of his presence in every circumstance a life transformed by letting God in is not a theoretical concept but a living reality we can look to stories like Paul who went from persecuting Christians to being one of the greatest Apostles his life shows that no one is too far from God's transforming touch each of us can be a living testimony of God's grace love and Power by saying yes to God we open our lives to Blessings joy and the Fulfillment that the

world cannot give let God work in your life now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God Heavenly Father we give you all glory honor and praise now and forevermore Lord I come before you with an open heart acknowledging your greatness and your love for

me o God created me a clean heart and renew a steadfast Spirit Within Me Lord I acknowledge my sins and see and seek your forgiveness in the name of Jesus I Repent of my wrongdoings and I ask for your grace to guide me in living a life that honors and glorifies you Lord I Thank you for your desire to work in my life Mighty God forgive me for sometimes resisting and trying to take control of things myself in the name of

Jesus I rebuke any Spirit of Doubt fear or self-reliance that may hold me back from fully embracing your will for my life I declare in the name of Jesus that I will trust you more knowing that your plans are perfect and your ways are higher than my ways Lord I ask for the wisdom to discern your calling for my life and the courage to live purposefully in line with your divine plan father I embrace the faith and trust that the great

Heroes of Faith had in you in the name of Jesus I declare that I will have faith in action ready to step out and follow your leading even when I can't see the whole path ahead Lord I commit myself to prayer meditation and studying your word I thank you that my life will be transformed by surrendering to your will in the name of Jesus I rebuke any barriers that may hinder your work in me Lord I invite your Holy Spirit to

mold me shape me and use Me For Your Glory father I declare that I will experience your peace joy and blessings as I walk with you I will not be afraid for I know that you will never leave me nor forsake me I give you thanks for your Divine protection healing and mercies father I thank you for all that you have done and for all that you are about to do in my life Lord I also lift up my loved ones

to you asking that they open their hearts to allow you to work in their lives in the name of Jesus may they surrender to your will embrace your love and experience your transformative power thank you Lord for hearing and answering my prayer in the mighty name of Jesus I pray trusting in your love your power and your promises amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comments section below you can help us to reach more

persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all your support you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory and we also invite other

believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now to God be all the glory I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
